note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Bare & false grant (deepseek, glm, minimax; also found independently before the panel returned): & now separates commands unless part of a redirection (2>&1, &>). Command-substitution false grant (deepseek): fallback no longer grants on a segment carrying unquoted $( or a backtick. Doc too absolute (deepseek, INV-2): hooks.md now says the prefix also escapes an over-detected non-commit command. Also fixed from own attack before the panel returned: env KARTA_SKIP_GATE=1 git commit was a false deny.
findings_refuted_or_deferred: deepseek: (KARTA_SKIP_GATE=1 git commit -m x) false deny — ws[0][0] is the word text, not its first character; that exact row is in the truth table and passes. minimax: KARTA_"SKIP_GATE"=1 should grant — bash recognises assignment words on unquoted text, so a quoted name is a command name, not an assignment; deny is correct. minimax: KARTA_SKIP_GATE=1 ( cd sub && ... ) — an assignment cannot prefix a subshell in bash, it is a syntax error. minimax: KARTA_SKIP_GATE=1 . ./script.sh — the detector does not fire on it, so the gate never runs.
